title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Personal domestic activities This service assists a participant to undertake or develop skills to maintain their home environment where the participant owns their own home or has sole or substantial responsibility for its maintenance. This Includes assisting participants to do basic house and yard work. Your domestic plan includes Gardening Support workers can assist NDIS participants with gardening tasks, creating an enjoyable and accessible outdoor space. This includes weeding, planting, and maintaining gardens, tailored to the participant’s preferences and capabilities. Gardening provides therapeutic benefits, promoting relaxation and a sense of achievement. Cleaning Cleaning support encompasses maintaining a clean and hygienic living environment. This involves tasks like dusting, vacuuming, and tidying, ensuring the participant’s home is comfortable and safe. Support workers adapt their cleaning methods to suit the specific needs and preferences of the participant. Meal Preparation Support workers aid in meal preparation, ensuring dietary needs and preferences are met. This includes planning, cooking, and possibly assisting with eating. Emphasis is placed on preparing nutritious meals that cater to the health requirements of the participant, fostering their independence and enjoyment of food.
